generation.explanation: A line of best fit (ordinary least squares regression) finds the unique straight line y = mx + b that minimizes the sum of squared vertical residuals between the line and the data points. Drag any yellow point to move it; the slope m, intercept b, and the red fit line update instantly from the closed-form formulas m = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy)/(nΣx² − (Σx)²) and b = (Σy − mΣx)/n.
